nights.title: Luka Bloom
nights.name: Luka Bloom
nights.extract: Kevin Barry Moore, known professionally as Luka Bloom, is an Irish folk singer-songwriter. He is the younger brother of folk singer Christy Moore.

nights.title: The Bootleg Beatles
nights.name: The Bootleg Beatles
nights.extract: The Bootleg Beatles are a Beatles tribute band. They have performed over 4,000 times since their establishment in March 1980.
